name: Realtime Ambilight
description: Server-side realtime Ambilight output to WLED
overview: Realtime HDR-aware ambient lighting for Jellyfin playback

versions.changelog: Jellyfin 12 support: retargeted to net10.0 and Jellyfin.Controller/Model/Common 12.0.0, now that Jellyfin 12 is out and the developer's own server has been upgraded to it. No code changes were needed -- the plugin never used any of the interfaces Jellyfin 12 changed or removed. A build targeting a newer .NET than the host server cannot load, so this could not ship until the real upgrade happened; installs on Jellyfin 10.11.x should stay on 0.3.0. Also fixes WLED smoothing and Hue responsivity: both still filled right-to-left, the one remaining trace of an earlier, reverted slider redesign, while every other slider on the page fills left-to-right in the same green.

Simplifies the calibration wizard to seven swatch-only steps (the photo-finetuning phase is gone) and adds a 20-minute idle auto-disarm so an admin who never clicks Finish does not leave the anonymous TV-facing surface reachable forever. Adds a one-click test-video library: nine short, synthetic (ffmpeg-generated, no licensing question) clips embedded in the plugin, extracted and registered as a real temporary Jellyfin library on demand, torn down again with one click. Grows the Live tuning panel from 5 to 9 fields -- colour intensity, black level floor, sampling edge range and white LED strength were already live under the hood and just were not living where that was obvious -- and adds a symmetric 2.5s fade-in at session start alongside the existing fade-out at stop. Collapses the 8-stage signal chain to 6 (three inline stages that never had their own data merge into one "LED processing" block) and fixes it to never scroll sideways on a narrow screen. Promotes several defaults (WLED brightness, colour intensity, black level floor, WLED smoothing, minimum colour hold, sampling edge range, Hue brightness, Hue responsivity) from untested guesses to a validated real-room baseline. Labels Hue Entertainment pre-alpha throughout the UI and docs -- the WLED output path is solid; Hue is not yet reliable.

Adds Philips Hue Entertainment as a second, independent realtime output alongside WLED (same picture, same bound TV, off by default). Adds a settings-page overhaul: overview cards that expand in place, one combined "edit all settings" page, live pipeline/device status, live activity log, device reachability pings, colour-deviation breakdown, and a reset-to-defaults action. Adds WLED settings management (realtime pixel offset, nightlight interference) and 200+ unit tests. Several real bugs found and fixed against physical hardware over multiple hands-on test rounds (see the project's ADRs and commit history).
First installable pre-alpha release: server-side video analysis driving WLED in realtime, with calibration and RGBW output. Hue integration was not yet included.
